_readme: The community story at the top of the phone app's Home (/app). Edit this file to change it. Every line must be supported by the source story linked in 'source'. Photos must already be in photos/ (never hotlink). The summary sits under the photo and doubles as its caption, so name who is pictured. 'focus' is where the photo is anchored when it is cropped to a wide strip: keep faces and medals in view. Remove the whole 'feature' block to hide the story.

feature.headline: Three national titles for Southwest.
feature.summary: Javier Goez and Angel Gomez, pictured, won the Men’s Pairs: one of three 2026 national titles for Southwest Division bowlers.

photo.alt: Javier Goez and Angel Gomez with their 2026 national championship certificates
